faqTitle: A little clarity before you order.
faqOneQ: Can I buy directly without requesting a quote?
faqOneA: Yes. Available catalogue packs can be added to your bag or purchased using Buy now. Delivery availability and the final total are checked at checkout.
faqTwoQ: What if I need bulk tea or my own packaging?
faqTwoA: Send your quantity, delivery pincode and packing requirements using the quotation form. Commercial terms are confirmed separately in writing.
faqThreeQ: Can I discuss my requirements on WhatsApp?
faqThreeA: Yes. Use Chat on WhatsApp to open a conversation. Submit the enquiry form first if you want a saved reference number.
